title: Construction Installation Readiness: Coordinate Parts, Site Access, and Crew Release
summary: Check installation dependencies independently before releasing crews or making customer commitments.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


An installation-readiness workflow should compare the approved work package with material allocation, site-access evidence and crew-release decisions. Each dependency needs its own owner and current status. An installation date in the CRM does not prove parts are available or a site is accessible. Use the workflow to collect evidence, identify blockers and route decisions. Purchasing, site coordination and dispatch retain authority over inventory commitments, access confirmation and actual crew assignment.


Explore the complete[construction services and installation integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/construction) for the systems and processes around this guide.
